No legacy Source5/6 relabeling, broad all-20, ACTUS, DeFi, recursion, private, multi-parent, U/M/MC/SP/G, bridge-closure, current-main, setup, key, proof, or Preprod claim was found in the new prose. The derived analysis remains separate at 6,132 nodes, 16,025 edges, and 353 communities, with 45 historical nodes omitted and all 76 Luna nodes retained.
